DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 払込票をお持ちですね。こちらで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a payment slip. I will check it here.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 電気代を払いたいのですが、期限が昨日までだったことに今気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電気代払込票の期限が過ぎた事情を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to pay my electricity bill, but I have only just noticed that the deadline was yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the deadline on your electricity bill payment slip has passed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 期限の欄とバーコードを見ますね。この票はレジで受付できるか確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will look at the deadline field and barcode. We need to check whether this slip can be accepted at the register.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 急いで払いたいです。読み取れなかったら、ここで新しい票を出せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: レジ受付不可の場合に再発行できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to pay as soon as possible. If it cannot be scanned, can you issue a new slip here?
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether a replacement slip can be issued if the register cannot accept it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発行元の票は当店では作り直せません。今回の票はレジで受付できないと表示されました。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot recreate the issuer's payment slips at our shop. The register shows that this slip cannot be accepted.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、電力会社に連絡します。どの番号が問い合わせ用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発行元の問い合わせ電話番号を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will contact the electricity company. Which number is for inquiries?
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the issuer's inquiry phone number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 票の下にある問い合わせ先が発行元の連絡先です。お客様番号もその近くにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The inquiry contact at the bottom of the slip is the issuer's contact information. Your customer number is near it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この番号を伝えて、支払い方法を聞けばよいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 問い合わせ時に伝える番号と用件を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I should give them this number and ask how to pay, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the number to provide and the purpose of your inquiry. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、期限が過ぎたこともお伝えください。票は折り目で番号が隠れないようお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, and tell them the deadline has passed. I will return the slip so that the fold does not hide the number.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 助かりました。今は支払いをせず、この票を持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 支払いを見送り払込票を持ち帰る意思を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: That helps. I will not pay now; I will take this slip home.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will postpone payment and take the payment slip home. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。票をお忘れなく、お気をつけてお帰りくださいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Do not forget the slip, and have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書の申請ですね。提出先から種類の指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are applying for a certificate. Has the recipient specified which type?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社に住所がわかる書類を出すよう言われましたが、書類の名前が書かれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勤務先が求める住所証明の名称が不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: My company told me to submit a document showing my address, but it does not give the document's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you do not know the name of the proof of address your employer requires. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会社の依頼文を拝見できますか。記載してほしい項目も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I see the company's request? Let us also check which information they need included.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このメールです。住所と氏名が必要で、家族の情報は不要とあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 依頼メールと必要記載項目を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is the email. It says the address and name are required, but family information is not needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Present the request email and the required information. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 住所を証明する書類にも種類があります。会社に具体的な名称を確認してから申請できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: There are different types of address-certifying documents. You can apply after checking the specific name with your company.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 間違ったものを取ると困るので、先に会社へ電話してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 誤申請を避けるため会社への確認電話を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Getting the wrong one would be a problem, so may I call my company first?
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Offer to call your company to avoid an incorrect application. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ。申請書はまだ出さずに、通話できる場所でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do. Do not submit the application yet; check in a place where you can make a call.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 担当者につながらないので、今日は書類を取らずに申請書だけ持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 担当者不在を伝え申請を延期する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I cannot reach the person in charge, so I will not obtain a document today and will just take the application form home.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the person in charge cannot be reached and postpone your application. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: わかりました。申請書の種類も決まってから選べますので、まず案内用紙をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. You can choose the application form after the document type is decided, so I will first give you an information sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、その用紙を会社に見せます。種類が決まったら必要な持ち物も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内用紙を使い種類と持ち物を確かめる予定を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will show that sheet to my company. Once the type is decided, I will also check what I need to bring.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe your plan to use the information sheet to confirm the document type and what to bring. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、また窓口でご相談ください。本日はありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please consult us at the counter again. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物のお受け取りですか。不在票を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you collecting a parcel? May I see the missed-delivery notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、寮の郵便受けに入っていました。本人確認用に在留カードも持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 寮で見つけた不在票と自分の身分証を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, it was in the dormitory mailbox. I also brought my residence card as identification.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Present the missed-delivery notice found at your dormitory and your own identification. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 不在票のお名前とカードのお名前が異なるようです。どなた宛ての荷物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The name on the notice seems different from the name on the card. Who is the parcel addressed to?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あ、本当に違います。同じ部屋の同僚の名前で、自分の荷物だと思い込んでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 不在票の宛名が同僚だと気づいたことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Oh, it really is different. It is my roommate colleague's name; I had assumed it was my parcel.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have realized the notice is addressed to your colleague. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それでは、ご本人への引き渡しではありませんね。代理受取には荷物に応じた確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then this would not be a handover to the addressee. Collection by a proxy requires checks depending on the parcel.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同僚から受け取りを頼まれたわけではありません。勝手に受け取るのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 代理依頼がないため受取を取りやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: My colleague did not ask me to collect it. I will not take it without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Cancel collection because you have not been asked to act as a proxy. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。不在票を同僚の方にお渡しいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Could you give the notice to your colleague?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 渡します。仕事から帰ってすぐ知らせたいので、保管期限の欄を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人に知らせるため保管期限の記載箇所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will. I want to tell them as soon as I get home from work, so please show me the holding-deadline field.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask where the holding deadline is written so you can inform the addressee. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらに日付が書かれています。ご本人から、受け取り方法をご相談いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The date is written here. The addressee can contact us to discuss how to collect it.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この日付も伝えて、本人に連絡してもらいます。私のカードは返していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同僚への連絡と自分の身分証返却を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell them this date too and ask them to contact you. Could you return my card?
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will contact your colleague and ask for your identification back. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、カードと不在票をお返しします。ご足労いただきました、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, here are your card and the notice. Thank you for making the trip. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込のご相談とのことですが、どちらから届いた案内ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about a bank transfer. Who sent you the instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 宅配会社の名前で、保管料を今日振り込むようにメッセージが来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 保管料の振込を求めるメッセージを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received a message in the name of a delivery company asking me to transfer a storage fee today.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Seek advice about a message requesting a transfer for a storage fee. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内の内容を見せていただけますか。送信者はお知り合いでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show me the message? Do you know the sender?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 知らない番号です。荷物を頼んだ覚えもなくて、不審に思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 知らない送信者と荷物注文の心当たりがないことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is an unknown number. I do not remember ordering any parcel, so I find it suspicious.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the sender is unknown and you do not recall ordering a parcel. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのまま振り込まず、正規の連絡先で確認しましょう。メッセージのリンクは開きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not transfer the money straightaway; let us check through an official contact. Have you opened the link in the message?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: リンクは開いていません。載っている電話番号にかけるのも避けた方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: リンク未開封と電話連絡の安全な方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not opened it. Should I avoid calling the phone number listed there too?
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have not opened the link and ask about a safe way to make phone contact. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: メッセージの番号ではなく、ご自身で確かめた公式の連絡先をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Use official contact information you have verified yourself, rather than the number in the message.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。念のため送信者に返事もしないでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不審な送信者へ返信を控える判断を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. To be safe, I will not reply to the sender either.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain your decision not to reply to the suspicious sender. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それがよいですね。口座情報や暗証番号などは送っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: That is a good idea. Have you sent any account information, PIN, or similar details?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 何も送っていません。振込用に下ろしたお金は、今日は使わず持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 個人情報を送っておらず送金を見送ると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have sent nothing. I will not use the money I withdrew for the transfer today; I will take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not sent personal information and will not make the transfer. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 不安な場合は、またご相談ください。お金に気をつけてお帰りくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please consult us again if you are worried. Keep your money safe on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地図をお探しですか。今いらっしゃる場所をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a map? I will explain where you are now.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と別々に歩いてしまいました。私は橋を渡ったばかりですが、今いる場所の名前がわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 橋を渡った現在地の名称がわからないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend and I ended up walking separately. I have just crossed a bridge, but I do not know the name of my current location.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have crossed a bridge but do not know the name of your current location. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 橋の近くの案内板に名前が出ています。友人の方は何を目印にされていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The name is on a sign near the bridge. What landmark is your friend using?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 天守が目の前に見えると言っています。私も同じ場所だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の目印と自分の思い違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: They say they can see the castle keep right in front of them. I thought I was in the same place too.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your friend's landmark and your own mistaken assumption. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見える建物が同じでも、立っている場所は違うかもしれません。まず案内板の名前を送ってみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even if you can see the same building, you may be standing in different places. First try sending the name on the sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうします。二人とも動くと行き違うので、友人にはその場で待ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 行き違いを避け友人に待ってもらうと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will. If we both move, we may miss each other, so I will ask my friend to wait where they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to have your friend wait so that you do not miss each other. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その間に、地図で友人の位置を確かめられます。送ってもらった写真などはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: In the meantime, we can check your friend's position on the map. Have they sent you a photo or anything similar?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この案内板の写真が届きました。私の現在地からどの道で近づけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 届いた案内板の写真から経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: This photo of a sign has arrived. Which path can I take from my current position to get closer?
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a route based on the photo of a sign you received. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二つの案内板を地図で照合しましょう。道がわかったら、移動するのはお一人と決めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us match both signs to the map. Once you know the route, decide that only one of you will move.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私が向かうと連絡します。道の途中で迷ったら、また立ち止まって場所を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分だけが移動し迷えば現在地を再確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell them I am coming. If I get lost along the way, I will stop again and check my location.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that only you will move and that you will recheck your location if lost. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、落ち着いて合流してくださいね。それでは、よい散策を。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, stay calm as you meet up. Enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れの方は、少しお疲れのようですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your companion looks a little tired.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母が階段で疲れてしまいました。人の通りを邪魔せず休める場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行する母の疲れと休憩場所の希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: My mother got tired on the stairs. Is there somewhere she can rest without obstructing people passing through?
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your accompanying mother is tired and that you want somewhere to rest. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内図で休める場所を探しましょう。今、痛みや息苦しさなどはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us look for a rest area on the map. Is she experiencing any pain or difficulty breathing now?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 息は落ち着いていますが、膝がつらいそうです。上まで行くか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在の体調と参拝継続への迷いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: Her breathing is calm, but she says her knees are troubling her. We are unsure whether to go all the way up.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain her current condition and your uncertainty about continuing the worship visit. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 無理に進まず、まず休んでから判断してください。お二人は一緒に動かれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not push on; rest first and then decide. Will the two of you move together?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、母を一人にしません。私は予定していた御朱印の受付も、今日は急がなくて大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 母と離れず御朱印より休息を優先すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I will not leave my mother alone. I also do not need to rush today to the sacred-seal reception I had planned to visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will stay with your mother and prioritize rest over obtaining a sacred seal. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それなら、休憩を優先できますね。通路の端で立ち止まる際も、周囲の方にお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then you can prioritize resting. Even when stopping at the edge of a path, please watch out for others around you.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 落ち着いたら下へ戻るか相談します。道の案内をもう一度見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 下へ戻る可能性を伝え経路図を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: Once she feels settled, we will discuss whether to go back down. Could you show me the route guide again?
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you may go back down and ask for the route map. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どうぞ、現在地はこちらです。体調が悪くなったら、近くの職員に声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: Of course; your current location is here. If she feels worse, please speak to a nearby staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 地図を写真に残します。今日は母の様子を見ながら、歩く距離を短くします。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 地図を残し歩行距離を短くする方針を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take a photo of the map. Today we will shorten the walking distance while watching how my mother is feeling.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep a copy of the map and shorten the walking distance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ無理なさらずに。それでは、お二人ともお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do not push yourselves. Both of you, take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 傘をお探しとのことですが、いつ頃お持ちでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking for an umbrella. Around when did you last have it?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三十分ほど前、参拝する前には持っていました。どこかで置いてしまったようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 傘を最後に持っていた時刻と場面を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: About thirty minutes ago, before worshipping. I seem to have left it somewhere.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say when and in what situation you last had the umbrella. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 置いたかもしれない場所と、傘の特徴を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me where you might have left it and what the umbrella looks like.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 手を洗うときに横へ置いた気がします。黒い長い傘で、持ち手に赤いひもがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 傘を置いた可能性のある場所と特徴を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: I think I put it beside me when washing my hands. It is a long black umbrella with a red cord on the handle.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain where you may have left it and its identifying features. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付に届いた傘があるか確認します。お連れの方が持っている可能性はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check whether an umbrella has been handed in at reception. Is it possible your companion has it?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人で来たので、それはありません。もし届いていなければ、自分で通った道を戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者がいないことと通路を戻る希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: I came alone, so that is not possible. If it has not been handed in, I would like to retrace my route myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have no companion and would like to retrace the path. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 届いたものの特徴とは異なるようです。探す際は、立ち入れる通路だけをご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: It seems different from the umbrella that was handed in. When searching, use only paths you are allowed to enter.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。受付にもう一度寄って、見つかったかどうかお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 捜索結果を受付へ知らせると申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will stop at reception again and let you know whether I found it.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Offer to inform reception of the search result. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ほかの方の傘と取り違えないよう、ひもを確かめてくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. Please check the cord so you do not mistake someone else's umbrella for yours.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、似た傘があってもすぐには持ち出しません。まず持ち手をよく見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 似た傘を持ち出す前に特徴を確認すると約束する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Even if I see a similar umbrella, I will not take it straightaway. I will look closely at the handle first.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Promise to check the features before taking a similar umbrella. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 見つかることを願っています。それでは、足元にお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: I hope you find it. Watch your step.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾得物のお届けですね。何を拾われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are reporting found property. What did you find?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帰宅中に茶色い財布を拾いました。中身には触らず、この袋に入れて持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾った財布の特徴と中身に触れていない扱いを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found a brown wallet on my way home. I did not touch its contents; I put it in this bag and brought it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe the wallet you found and say that you did not touch its contents. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。拾った場所と時刻を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you. Could you tell me where and when you found it?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 午後六時頃です。駅から帰る途中の交差点ですが、道の名前がわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発見時刻と通りの名称が不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around six in the evening. It was at an intersection on my way home from the station, but I do not know the street name.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the discovery time and that you do not know the street name. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 地図で確認しましょう。近くのお店や、横断歩道の位置は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check on a map. Do you remember nearby shops or the position of the pedestrian crossing?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: パン屋の向かい側です。横断歩道を渡り終えたところの植え込みの横でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 店と横断歩道を目印に発見位置を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was opposite a bakery, beside the shrubs just after I finished crossing the pedestrian crossing.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Indicate the location using the shop and pedestrian crossing as landmarks. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの角でしょうか。届けの記録に、その位置を記載します。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would it be this corner? I will enter that location in the report.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その角です。拾ったあと誰かに渡さず、そのままこちらへ来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 地図上の位置と拾得後の経緯を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: That is the corner. After finding it, I did not give it to anyone else and came straight here.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the position on the map and what you did after finding it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。このあとの連絡に必要な事項を、順に確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please let me check the information needed for further contact in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。難しい言葉があったら、意味を説明してから記入させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 届けの難しい記入用語の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. If there are difficult terms, please explain their meanings before I fill them in.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for explanations of difficult terms on the report form. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: もちろんです。それでは記録を仕上げましょう、お届けいただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: Of course. Let us finish the record. Thank you for bringing it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お薬の説明を始める前に、お名前を確認いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before explaining your medicine, I will confirm your name.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 袋の名前が私の名前と違うようです。まだ開けていないので、確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 薬袋の氏名相違と未開封を伝え照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: The name on the bag seems different from mine. I have not opened it yet; could you check?
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the medicine bag has a different name and is unopened, and ask for a comparison. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申し訳ありません。袋をこちらにお戻しいただき、ご本人の氏名を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: I am sorry. Please return the bag here and tell me your own full name.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: グエン・ミンです。受付ではこの処方箋を出しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の氏名と提出した処方箋を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: Nguyen Minh. I submitted this prescription at reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your own full name and show the prescription you submitted. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 処方箋と調剤の記録を照合します。先ほど別のお薬を受け取られてはいませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will compare the prescription with the dispensing record. Did you receive any other medicine earlier?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: これが最初の受け取りです。間違った薬を飲むところでしたが、気づいてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今回が最初の受取で未服用と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: This is my first collection. I nearly took the wrong medicine, but I am glad I noticed.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that this is your first collection and you have not taken the medicine. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お待ちいただいている間に確認を進めます。確認が済むまで、袋の中のお薬は使わないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check while you wait. Please do not use any medicine in the bag until we have finished checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もちろん使いません。正しい袋を受け取るときも、名前を一緒に読ませてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 正しい薬袋の氏名を職員と読む希望を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: Of course I will not. When I receive the correct bag, please let me read the name together with you as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to read the name on the correct medicine bag together with a staff member. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、照合が済みましたので、ご本人の袋を確認しながら改めて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, we have completed the comparison, so I will explain again while checking your own bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その前に、最初の袋を私が返したことも記録しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 誤った薬袋の返却を記録するよう求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: Before that, please also record that I returned the first bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for the return of the incorrect medicine bag to be recorded. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 返却も記録します。お待たせしました、お帰りの際はどうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will record its return too. Thank you for waiting, and please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのカップを贈り物にされますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、明日同僚に渡します。今日は電車で帰るので、割れないように包んでほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 贈り物を電車で運ぶため保護包装を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I will give it to a colleague tomorrow. I am going home by train today, so I would like it wrapped to prevent breakage.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request protective packaging because you will take the gift on a train. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 箱に入れて保護材を使う包装をご案内できます。持ち手のある袋も必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can offer packaging in a box with protective material. Do you also need a bag with handles?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 片手に仕事のかばんがあるので、持ち手のある丈夫な袋をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手荷物の状況に合う持ち手付き袋を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my work bag in one hand, so please give me a sturdy bag with handles.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for a handled bag suited to your other luggage. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: かしこまりました。贈り物用の紙は二種類あり、こちらは別料金です。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: Certainly. We have two types of gift paper, and this one costs extra.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 飾りより安全に運ぶことを優先したいので、追加料金のない紙を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 安全性を優先し追加料金のない包装を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to prioritize safe transport over decoration, so I will choose the paper without an extra charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Prioritize safety and choose wrapping without an extra charge. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、その紙で包みます。値段のわかる札は外してよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then I will wrap it in that paper. May I remove the tag showing the price?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 外してください。ただ、使い方の説明は相手に渡したいので残してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 価格札を外し説明書を残す希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please remove it. But I want to give the instructions for use to the recipient, so please leave those.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the price tag to be removed and the instructions retained. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 説明書は箱の中に残します。包み終えたら、持ち方も一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will leave the instructions in the box. After wrapping, let us also check how to carry it.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。帰りは箱を上向きにして、袋を足元で押しつぶさないよう持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱の向きと袋を圧迫しない運び方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. On my way home I will keep the box upright and carry the bag so that it is not crushed at my feet.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the box orientation and how to carry the bag without crushing it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、大切にお持ちください。贈り物が喜ばれるとよいですね、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please carry it carefully. I hope the gift is well received. Thank you.
